message:
Well, if you're teaching writing (or anything), you want the students to be metacognitive, so how can they not "prepare ahead of time"--that's a good thing!  But you know that, right?
I guess I'd think about asking (tactfully)what point is there in having students write that final essay in a timed environment with no previous preparation?  How does it serve their training to be military officers?  I mean, this kind of time-structured- think -on -the -fly kind of behavior is better tested in a military science (?) classroom.
And then I'd see about encouraging folks to go to the 4C's with you this year, or bringing in writing scholars who can help persuade.
But Bradley is right on with his vivid simile of the salmon--let me add that the salmon, in Irish myth, symbolizes intelligence, so take heart.
